listings.rawTitle: Yum Lip Balm Holder Charm - Green
listings.description: A sweet little sidekick for your fave lip essential! The Yum Lip Balm Holder Charm keeps your Cashmere Kiss Lip Balm close, turning a daily must-have into the cutest accessory. With its diamond-shaped holder and secure clip, it hooks effortlessly onto bags and keychains, so your lips stay glossed and hydrated wherever you go! .

Home sweet home for all your Yum faves! The Yum Beauty Pouch is crafted from soft-touch silicone in our Yum gourmand hues, adding a playful pop to your everyday layering ritual. Lightweight, flexible, and easy to clean, it slips into your bag or sits pretty on your vanity, keeping your fragrance, body care, and beauty essentials together wherever you go..
